title: GitHub - "Github Services" Feature Webhook Brownout
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: "Github Services" Feature Webhook Brownout
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2018-12-12T18:15:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2018-12-13T18:15:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2018-12-13T18:15:31.857Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2018-12-12T18:15:59.100Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2018-12-12T17:59:46.227Z: scheduled - As part of the deprecation process of the "GitHub Services" feature, we have commenced the 24 hour brownout of services webhook deliveries. All other systems are operating normally. More information can be found in https://git.io/fpf5g.

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

As part of the deprecation process of the "GitHub Services" feature, we have commenced the 24 hour brownout of services webhook deliveries. All other systems are operating normally. More information can be found in https://git.io/fpf5g.
